title: A Minimal Execution Architecture for Bounded Korean Communication

creators.name: Choi, Wonsik
creators.affiliation: Independent Researcher, Seoul, Republic of Korea

description:
Bilingual WRRA Core 2.1 research manuscript with 100 annotated Korean utterances, 16 development variants, a 96-case benchmark, code and measurement scripts. Contact: janefather@gmail.com.

The 10-bit bound applies to a separate exact relation-retention task. The revised rule implementation scores 96/96 on the bounded development suite and 13/100 on the original utterances.
